About the IQAC

Internal Quality Assurance Cell, MRU

Manav Rachna University (MRU), established under the Haryana State Legislature Act No. 26 of 2014, is a leading private state university in Haryana recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956. The university holds an ‘A’ grade from NAAC (2024–2029) and NBA accreditation for its B.Tech. CSE programme (2023–2026), and is the first university in India to be accredited with the International Baccalaureate (IB).

The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) at MRU is committed to upholding the highest standards in higher education through systematic assessment, accreditation, and continuous enhancement strategies — ensuring academic and administrative functions align with national and international benchmarks.

About Quality Assurance & Accreditation

Manav Rachna University (MRU), established under the Haryana State Legislature Act No. 26 of 2014, is a leading private state university in Haryana recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956. The university holds an ‘A’ grade from NAAC (2024–2029) and NBA accreditation for its B.Tech. CSE programme (2023–2026), and is the first university in India to be accredited with the International Baccalaureate (IB).

The Quality Assurance & Accreditation (QAA) office at MRU is committed to upholding the highest standards in higher education through systematic assessment, accreditation, and continuous enhancement strategies — ensuring academic and administrative functions align with national and international benchmarks.

Levels of Quality Enhancement

Institutional Level

Curriculum development, faculty development, student engagement, extracurricular activities, and infrastructure enhancement aligned with the university's vision and mission.

National Level

Accreditation and recognition from UGC, AICTE, NAAC, NIRF, NBA, BCI and NCTE, plus external assessments, rankings and industry collaborations.

International Level

Global partnerships, faculty and student exchange programmes, collaborative research, international internships and participation in THE and QS ranking frameworks.

Quality Assurance Channels

  • Student Feedback — course evaluations and satisfaction surveys
  • Faculty Inputs — course reviews and curriculum enhancements
  • External Examiners & Industry Feedback
  • Parents–Teachers Meetings
  • Alumni & Employer Feedback

Role of the IQAC

The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) is involved in the systematic implementation of quality enhancement procedures and criteria to attain improved levels of international compatibility and competitiveness at the institutional and programme level. This involves continuous monitoring, evaluation, revision and implementation of academic and administrative procedures across the university.

Key responsibilities of the IQAC include:

  • Ensuring timely, efficient performance of academic, administrative and financial tasks.
  • Optimizing and integrating modern teaching-learning methods, including outcome-based education (OBE).
  • Documenting the various programmes, activities and initiatives leading to quality improvement.
  • Acting as a nodal agency for coordinating quality-related, institution-wide activities.
  • Developing and applying quality benchmarks for the various academic and administrative activities of the institution.
  • Organizing workshops, seminars, and Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs) on quality-related themes.
  • Recording and monitoring quality measures, and preparing the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR) based on quality parameters.
  • Facilitating the creation of a learner-centric environment conducive to quality education.

Achievements

Accreditations, ratings and recognitions of Manav Rachna University collated from the official IQAC and university website (mru.edu.in), reflecting the outcomes of MRU's quality assurance framework.

NAAC 'A' Grade Accreditation

2024–2029

Manav Rachna University holds an 'A' grade from the National Assessment and Accreditation Council, reaffirming institutional quality across teaching, research and governance.

NBA Accreditation — B.Tech. CSE

2023–2026

The Computer Science & Engineering programme is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation, certifying it meets national outcome-based education standards.

First IB-Accredited University in India

Ongoing

MRU became the first university in India to be accredited by the International Baccalaureate, reflecting its commitment to global education standards.

QS I-GAUGE Diamond Rating

Institutional Level

MRU earned the QS I-GAUGE Diamond rating at the institutional level, with Platinum ratings in Teaching & Learning, Social Responsibility, Governance & Structure and Academic Development, and a Diamond rating in Faculty Quality, Employability, Diversity & Accessibility and Facilities.

IIRF India Rankings 2026

National Ranking

Manav Rachna University was recognised as a premier hub for Engineering and Management education in Haryana and India in the IIRF India Rankings 2026.

Times Higher Education Sustainability Impact Ratings 2026

Global Band 801–1000

MRU secured an Overall Global Band of 801–1000, with strong performances across SDG 16, SDG 5 & 17, SDG 4, and SDG 3 & 8.

Platinum Band — SII Green Rankings 2026

Sustainability Leadership

Recognised as an Institution of Sustainability Leadership and awarded the Platinum Band in the Sustainable Institutions of India (SII) Green Rankings 2026.

ISO 9001 / 14001 / 50001 Certifications

Quality, Environment & Energy

MRU maintains integrated ISO certifications for Quality Management, Environmental Management and Energy Management Systems, audited and surveilled annually.

ANRF Financial Assistance for ISSP 2024

Up to ₹1.2 Lakh

A faculty/researcher was awarded financial assistance from the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) of up to ₹1.2 lakh for participation in ISSP 2024.

North Cap Moot Court Competition, 2024

School of Law

MRU School of Law participated in the North Cap Moot Court Competition, 2024, showcasing strength in legal advocacy and research.

Source: official MRU / IQAC website (mru.edu.in/university/iqac). Figures and bands are as published there and may be updated by the university periodically.
